name: Schär Artisan Baker Gluten-Free White Bread
whyItWorks: Baked in Europe using a traditional gluten-free sourdough starter with fine rice and millet flours. Natural fermentation pre-digests starches, resulting in a tender, gut-friendly crumb that does not require toasting to stay soft.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ready to eat straight out of the packaging. Store leftover slices in an airtight bag.
